dedupe_keys.name: physics informed neural networks for cold chain digital twins

description: The study authors publish a physics-informed neural-network notebook for a one-dimensional cold-storage wall. Zenodo supplies a ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The model embeds the transient heat equation and uses sparse, noisy synthetic sensor readings to reconstruct wall-temperature profiles. It estimates inner-surface heat flux and compares the result with an explicit finite-difference calculation. An insulation what-if scenario changes the calculated one-hour cooling load. This model can test energy-efficiency assumptions in food or pharmaceutical cold-chain simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this proof-of-concept. Coverage is a one-dimensional wall and synthetic readings; refrigeration equipment, door openings and actual vaccine or food spoilage are outside the demonstrated model. A limitation is that the reported agreement and savings were not independently checked. The archive was not downloaded or run, so dependencies and reproducibility remain unverified.
